To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
two IgG2A mAbs, 101C11 and the 30H12, were raised from mice immunized with live MenB and were bactericidal in vitro for MenB.
Two IgG2a mAb have been generated from mice immunized with live Men B.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the bactericidal epitops of the capsule of Men B and their relationship with the fine specificity of protective antibodies.
the fine specificity of protective anti-Men B antibodies.
a better knowledge of the fine specificity of protective IgG response against the Men B capsule.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the two mAb recognize two distinct bactericidic epitopes, one of which is conformational and the other one is linear.
the fine specificity of bactericidal IgG response for Men B capsule, as defined by the 101C11 and the 30H12 mAb, is directed towards conformational epitopes.
the two bactericidal mAb 101C11 and, to a lesser extent, 30H12 recognize different bactericidal epitopic regions on the surface of live Men B.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the two antibodies are bactericidal, but only one is protective.
